about.headline: Crafting with technical rigor,
about.roleCategory: SOFTWARE ENGINEERING · FOCUS ON BACKEND & AI
about.quote: “I believe that great software unites logical precision and aesthetic sensibility — turning the complex into something simple and enjoyable for the user.”
bioParagraphs: I am a Software Engineering undergraduate at Pontifícia Universidade Católica de Minas Gerais (PUC Minas), passionate about the intersection between rigorous logic, systems architecture, and thoughtful interface design.

I believe building good software goes beyond writing functional code: it is about delivering pleasant, intuitive, and purpose-driven products. I cultivate a disciplined routine of continuous learning, diving deep into computer science fundamentals, object-oriented programming with Java, and the modern web ecosystem with JavaScript and React.

I operate natively with Artificial Intelligence, leveraging cutting-edge AI models and developer agents to explore novel ideas, rapidly prototype solutions, debug complex architectures, and sustain a productive engineering workflow, always applying critical judgment over code elegance and maintainability.

projects.headline: Selected projects,
projects.gvsTagline: Complete overhaul of the company digital presence and corporate portal
projects.gvsDesc: A real professional project conceived and developed entirely by me for Grupo GVS, redesigning the brand's digital image for the clean energy generation market. Features power plant architecture, careers portal, and socio-environmental initiatives.
projects.xulambisTagline: Pizzeria ordering and management system developed in Java (OOP)
projects.xulambisDesc: An academic project developed collaboratively in class at PUC Minas, simulating the backend and operational logic of a pizzeria. Built with strict Object-Oriented Programming, inventory management, dynamic ingredient calculation, and an interactive terminal CLI interface.
